name: Power Button
author: Edgar Silva
description: A power button for the bar with a keyboard-navigable session menu: screens off, lock, suspend, shutdown, reboot, logout.

barWidget.description: One click opens a session menu. Arrow keys or number keys pick an action; destructive ones confirm first. Actions run Omarchy's own omarchy-system or omarchy-system-lock command where one exists, and the same commands Omarchy's own system menu runs where none does.

schema.label: Actions
schema.description: Which actions the menu offers. Leave empty to show them all.

options.label: Turn screens off
options.description: Hyprland DPMS off — the only action with no omarchy-* script behind it

options.label: Suspend
options.description: systemctl suspend — hidden while the suspend-off toggle is set

options.label: Hibernate
options.description: systemctl hibernate — only offered where omarchy-hibernation-available succeeds

schema.label: Ask before running
schema.description: Destructive actions means Shutdown, Reboot, and Logout — the three that lose unsaved work.

schema.label: Right click on the bar icon
schema.description: Runs straight away without opening the menu, and without the confirmation prompt.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar.

schema.label: Group the menu into Screen and Session
Show a line of description under each action
schema.description: Turn off for a compact menu.

schema.label: Show the number key beside each action
Turn screens off command
schema.description: Leave empty for Hyprland's DPMS dispatcher. The only action with no Omarchy script behind it.

schema.label: Delay before turning screens off (ms)
schema.description: Gives the mouse button time to come back up. Without it the release can wake the displays straight back on.
